data.smt_query:
; Freehold SMT-LIB query
(set-logic ALL)
(declare-const String Int)
(declare-const UNSUPPORTED Int)
(declare-const first_quantity Int)
(declare-const first_warehouse_id Int)
(declare-const instr Int)
(declare-const result Int)
(declare-const second_warehouse_id Int)
(declare-const third_warehouse_id Int)
(assert (> first_quantity 0))
(assert (= second_warehouse_id first_warehouse_id))
(assert (> third_warehouse_id 0))
(assert (not (>= (String.instr result UNSUPPORTED) 0)))
(check-sat)
; unsat means proved
